# Overview {-}

**Question.** Do exercise or rapamycin change bulk Coomassie-stained soluble and insoluble protein content, or the insoluble-to-soluble ratio, in Old skeletal muscle, and does the effect depend on sex?

| Item | As implemented below |
|---|---|
| Input | `Aggregates_Sol and Insoluble Coomassie_Mesquita.xlsx` (repeated header rows are removed) |
| Groups | Old sedentary (Ctl), Old exercise (Ex), Old rapamycin (Rapa); Female and Male |
| Values | Raw values (`use_normalized <- FALSE`); outcomes Soluble, Insoluble and Insol/Sol ratio |
| Model (each outcome) | `lm(Value ~ Treatment * Sex)` with sum-to-zero contrasts; Type III ANOVA (`car::Anova`, F tests) for Treatment, Sex and Treatment × Sex |
| Planned contrasts | Ex - Ctl and Rapa - Ctl within each sex (`emmeans`), **unadjusted** (`adjust = "none"`); saved to `Bulk_OT_trt_within_sex.csv` |
| Figures | Bars = treatment mean ± SEM pooled across sexes; points = individual animals shaped by sex; subtitle *P* values are the Type III terms |

The unit of replication is the animal. Figures are saved to `Bulk_OT/` (PNG, 300 dpi) and are also shown in this report right after the chunk that creates them.

> **To run:** put the input workbook next to this file and knit. Tables are written to `Bulk_OT/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, cache = FALSE)

options(width = 120)
```

# Packages

All packages must be installed beforehand (the script stops and lists any that are missing; it does not install anything). They are attached in the original order, which decides which functions mask which.

```{r packages}
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "broom", "emmeans", "car", "ggtext", "patchwork",
          "scales", "grid")
missing_pkgs <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Install missing packages first: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
invisible(lapply(pkgs[1:9], library, character.only = TRUE))
```

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
darken_col <- function(col, factor = 0.70) {
  rgb_mat <- grDevices::col2rgb(col) / 255
  grDevices::rgb(red = rgb_mat[1, ] * factor, green = rgb_mat[2, ] * factor, blue = rgb_mat[3, ] * factor)
}

save_png <- function(plot_obj, filename, width, height, dpi = 300) {

  dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = filename,
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = "in",
      dpi = dpi,
      device = ragg::agg_png,
      bg = "white",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )

  } else {

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = filename,
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = "in",
      dpi = dpi,
      bg = "white",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (!file.exists(filename) || is.na(file.info(filename)$size) || file.info(filename)$size <= 0) {
    stop("PNG was not saved correctly: ", filename)
  }

  invisible(filename)
}

safe_write_csv <- function(x, filename) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      readr::write_csv(x, filename)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Could not write CSV to: ", filename, "\n", conditionMessage(e))
      invisible(NULL)
    }
  )
}

round_up_to <- function(x, base) {
  base * ceiling(x / base)
}

mean_sem <- function(x) {
  n <- sum(!is.na(x))
  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  se <- s / sqrt(n)

  tibble(n = n, mean = m, sd = s, sem = se)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

console_print <- function(x) {
  cat(paste(capture.output(print(x)), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  invisible(x)
}

theme_bulk <- function(base_size = 18) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 4),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, colour = "#4D4D4D"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black", size = base_size - 1),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.1),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.1),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}
```

# User settings

```{r settings}
# Input file
in_file <- "Aggregates_Sol and Insoluble Coomassie_Mesquita.xlsx"

# Output directory (kept short to avoid path issues)
out_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Bulk_OT")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# This is the analysis/source Rmd.
# Paper export is handled separately by the current Work-branch bridge/index workflow.

# Choose raw or normalized values
use_normalized <- FALSE

trt_cols <- c("Ctl" = "#59C761", "Ex" = "#F2D925", "Rapa" = "#64106E")

trt_labels <- c("Ctl" = "Old Ctl", "Ex" = "Old Ex", "Rapa" = "Old Rapa")

trt_fill_cols <- c(
  "Ctl" = scales::alpha(trt_cols[["Ctl"]], 0.42),
  "Ex" = scales::alpha(trt_cols[["Ex"]], 0.42),
  "Rapa" = scales::alpha(trt_cols[["Rapa"]], 0.42)
)

trt_border_cols <- c(
  "Ctl" = darken_col(trt_cols[["Ctl"]], factor = 0.72),
  "Ex" = darken_col(trt_cols[["Ex"]], factor = 0.72),
  "Rapa" = darken_col(trt_cols[["Rapa"]], factor = 0.72)
)

trt_point_cols <- c(
  "Ctl" = darken_col(trt_cols[["Ctl"]], factor = 0.58),
  "Ex" = darken_col(trt_cols[["Ex"]], factor = 0.58),
  "Rapa" = darken_col(trt_cols[["Rapa"]], factor = 0.58)
)

sex_shapes <- c("Female" = 21, "Male" = 24)

# Figure sizes
sep_w <- 7.2
sep_h <- 5.6
comb_w <- 10.6
comb_h <- 6.4
```

# Import and clean data

```{r import}
raw_df <- readxl::read_excel(in_file)

raw_df <- raw_df %>%
  filter(Group != "Group") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(RawSoluble, RawInsoluble, `RawInsol/Sol`, NormSoluble, NormInsoluble, `NormInsol/Sol`), as.numeric),
    Sex = str_to_title(as.character(Sex)),
    Group = str_squish(as.character(Group))
  )

bulk_df <- raw_df %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("Old sed", "Old ex", "Old rapa"), Sex %in% c("Female", "Male")) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      Group == "Old sed" ~ "Ctl",
      Group == "Old ex" ~ "Ex",
      Group == "Old rapa" ~ "Rapa",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Ctl", "Ex", "Rapa")),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

console_print(bulk_df)
```

# Build analysis table

```{r long-data}
measure_map <- if (use_normalized) {
  c(Soluble = "NormSoluble", Insoluble = "NormInsoluble", Ratio = "NormInsol/Sol")
} else {
  c(Soluble = "RawSoluble", Insoluble = "RawInsoluble", Ratio = "RawInsol/Sol")
}

bulk_long <- bind_rows(
  bulk_df %>% transmute(ID, Treatment, Sex, Outcome = "Soluble",   Value = .data[[measure_map[["Soluble"]]]]),
  bulk_df %>% transmute(ID, Treatment, Sex, Outcome = "Insoluble", Value = .data[[measure_map[["Insoluble"]]]]),
  bulk_df %>% transmute(ID, Treatment, Sex, Outcome = "Insol/Sol", Value = .data[[measure_map[["Ratio"]]]])
) %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Soluble", "Insoluble", "Insol/Sol")))

# Sex-specific summary retained for reporting/checking.
summary_sex_tbl <- bulk_long %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Treatment, Sex) %>%
  summarise(mean_sem(Value), .groups = "drop")

# Plotting summary: one bar per treatment, pooling females and males.
# Individual animals remain visible and are shape-coded by sex.
summary_tbl <- bulk_long %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_sem(Value), .groups = "drop")

safe_write_csv(summary_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_summary.csv"))

safe_write_csv(summary_sex_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_summary_bySex.csv"))

console_print(summary_tbl)
console_print(summary_sex_tbl)
```

# Statistics

```{r stats}
analyze_outcome <- function(df, outcome_name) {
  sub_df <- df %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name) %>%
    droplevels()

  contrasts(sub_df$Treatment) <- contr.sum(nlevels(sub_df$Treatment))
  contrasts(sub_df$Sex) <- contr.sum(nlevels(sub_df$Sex))

  fit <- lm(Value ~ Treatment * Sex, data = sub_df)

  a3 <- car::Anova(fit, type = 3)
  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(a3), value = TRUE)[1]

  anova_tbl <- tibble(Outcome = outcome_name, Term = rownames(a3), p_value = as.numeric(a3[, p_col])) %>%
    filter(Term %in% c("Treatment", "Sex", "Treatment:Sex"))

  em_trt_within_sex <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Treatment | Sex)

  trt_contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(
    em_trt_within_sex,
    method = list("Ex - Ctl" = c(-1, 1, 0), "Rapa - Ctl" = c(-1, 0, 1)),
    adjust = "none"
  ) %>%
    broom::tidy() %>%
    mutate(Outcome = outcome_name)

  list(fit = fit, anova = anova_tbl, contrasts = trt_contrasts)
}

stat_list <- setNames(
  lapply(levels(bulk_long$Outcome), function(x) analyze_outcome(bulk_long, x)),
  levels(bulk_long$Outcome)
)

anova_all <- bind_rows(lapply(stat_list, `[[`, "anova"))
contrast_all <- bind_rows(lapply(stat_list, `[[`, "contrasts"))

stats_wide <- anova_all %>%
  select(Outcome, Term, p_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Term, values_from = p_value) %>%
  mutate(stats_label = paste0("Trt=", fmt_p(Treatment), " | Sex=", fmt_p(Sex), " | Int=", fmt_p(`Treatment:Sex`)))

get_stats_label <- function(outcome_name) {
  stats_wide %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name) %>%
    pull(stats_label)
}

combined_stats_label <- paste0(
  "<b>Sol:</b> ", get_stats_label("Soluble"), "<br>",
  "<b>Insol:</b> ", get_stats_label("Insoluble"), "<br>",
  "<b>Insol/Sol:</b> ", get_stats_label("Insol/Sol")
)

safe_write_csv(anova_all, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_anova_type3.csv"))
safe_write_csv(contrast_all, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_trt_within_sex.csv"))
safe_write_csv(stats_wide, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_pvalues.csv"))

console_print(anova_all)
console_print(contrast_all)
console_print(stats_wide)
```

# Plot helpers

```{r plot-helpers}
make_sep_plot <- function(
  outcome_name,
  ylab_text,
  title_text,
  file_stub,
  y_labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
  expand_mult = c(0, 0.08)
) {

  sub_points <- bulk_long %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name)

  sub_sum <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name)

  p <- ggplot(sub_sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = Treatment, colour = Treatment), width = 0.64, linewidth = 1.2, alpha = .8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem, colour = Treatment), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.95) +
    geom_point(
      data = sub_points,
      aes(x = Treatment, y = Value, fill = Treatment, colour = Treatment, shape = Sex),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 1),
      size = 3.0,
      stroke = 0.95,
      alpha = 0.98
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = trt_fill_cols, breaks = names(trt_labels), labels = trt_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = trt_border_cols, breaks = names(trt_labels), labels = trt_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = sex_shapes, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = trt_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = y_labels, expand = expansion(mult = expand_mult)) +
    labs(title = title_text, subtitle = get_stats_label(outcome_name), x = NULL, y = ylab_text) +
    theme_bulk() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black", margin = margin(b = 5)),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  save_png(p, file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")), width = sep_w, height = sep_h)

  p
}
```

# Figure 4 — Combined figure

Bars show treatment means ± SEM pooled across sexes; individual animals are shape-coded by sex. Statistical inference remains based on the Treatment × Sex factorial model.

```{r fig-combined, fig.keep='none'}
content_max <- bulk_long %>%
  filter(Outcome %in% c("Soluble", "Insoluble")) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_val)

left_axis_max <- round_up_to(content_max * 1.20, 1e6)
right_axis_max <- 2.0
ratio_scale <- left_axis_max / right_axis_max

metric_centers <- c("Soluble" = 1, "Insoluble" = 2, "Insol/Sol" = 4)

trt_offsets <- c("Ctl" = -0.23, "Ex" = 0, "Rapa" = 0.23)

comb_sum <- summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    x = metric_centers[as.character(Outcome)] + trt_offsets[as.character(Treatment)],
    plot_mean = if_else(Outcome == "Insol/Sol", mean * ratio_scale, mean),
    plot_sem = if_else(Outcome == "Insol/Sol", sem * ratio_scale, sem)
  )

comb_pts <- bulk_long %>%
  mutate(
    x = metric_centers[as.character(Outcome)] + trt_offsets[as.character(Treatment)],
    plot_value = if_else(Outcome == "Insol/Sol", Value * ratio_scale, Value)
  )

make_combined_plot <- function(show_stats = FALSE) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_col(
      data = comb_sum,
      aes(x = x, y = plot_mean, fill = Treatment, colour = Treatment),
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 1.2,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = comb_sum,
      aes(x = x, ymin = plot_mean - plot_sem, ymax = plot_mean + plot_sem, colour = Treatment),
      width = 0.07,
      linewidth = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = comb_pts,
      aes(x = x, y = plot_value, fill = Treatment, colour = Treatment, shape = Sex),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.03, height = 0, seed = 1),
      size = 2.95,
      stroke = 0.95,
      alpha = 0.98
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linewidth = 1.05, linetype = "longdash", colour = "grey35") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = trt_fill_cols, breaks = names(trt_labels), labels = trt_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = trt_border_cols, breaks = names(trt_labels), labels = trt_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = sex_shapes, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2, 4),
      labels = c("Soluble", "Insoluble", "Insol/sol"),
      limits = c(0.5, 4.6),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Protein content (A.U.)",
      limits = c(0, left_axis_max),
      breaks = seq(0, left_axis_max, by = left_axis_max / 3),
      labels = label_scientific(digits = 2),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / ratio_scale, name = "Ratio", breaks = seq(0, right_axis_max, by = 0.5))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Soluble and insoluble proteins",
      subtitle = if (show_stats) combined_stats_label else NULL,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Protein content (A.U.)"
    ) +
    theme_bulk(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 270, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = if (show_stats) {
        ggtext::element_markdown(size = 13.5, colour = "black", lineheight = 1.18, margin = margin(b = 8))
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

p_combined <- make_combined_plot(show_stats = FALSE)
save_png(p_combined, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_Combined.png"), width = comb_w, height = comb_h)

p_combined_pvals <- make_combined_plot(show_stats = TRUE)
save_png(p_combined_pvals, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_Combined_pvals.png"), width = comb_w, height = comb_h + 0.7)

cat("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_Combined.png"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_OT_Combined_pvals.png"), "\n", sep = "")
```
